candidates.title: Collaborative Speculative Inference for Efficient LLM Inference Serving
candidates.reason: CoSine decouples drafting and verification across heterogeneous nodes, adds expert drafter routing, token fusion, pipelined orchestration and adaptive speculation control; reports 23.2% lower latency and 32.5% higher throughput at equivalent resource cost.

candidates.title: SwiftSpec: Ultra-Low Latency LLM Decoding by Scaling Asynchronous Speculative Decoding
candidates.reason: Asynchronous disaggregated speculative-decoding system with parallel tree generation, tree-aware KV management and fused kernels; reports 1.75x average speedup and 348 tok/s for Llama3-70B on 8 Hopper GPUs.

discovery_stats.axis: speculative decoding serving・draft/verification disaggregation・runtime scheduling
